QGC.MetaData.Facts.name: sourceMode
QGC.MetaData.Facts.longDesc: Connection priority preserves the existing receiver, NMEA, then device order. Automatic fallback selects a healthy source and delays returning to a recovered preferred source. A pinned source never falls back to another source.
QGC.MetaData.Facts.enumStrings: Connection priority,Automatic healthy source,Local receiver only,NMEA only,Device positioning only
QGC.MetaData.Facts.label: Position source
